walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 2: Performance — a core area of A-Level Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 2: Performance brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 2: Performance.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Whose 1953 Concentus Musicus Wien revived historically informed Baroque playing?
options: John Eliot Gardiner
Nikolaus Harnoncourt
Christopher Hogwood
Roger Norrington
Susan McClary
Christopher Small
Lawrence Kramer
Nicholas Cook

mcqs.q: What does modulation mean in music?
options: Adjusting volume electronically.
Changing from one key to another within a piece.
ii to V.
Changing tempo or dynamics.

mcqs.q: What is the function of the bridge in a pop song?
options: To provide contrast before the final chorus, often by changing melody, key, or texture.
It is the same as the chorus.
ii to V.
It is the very first section.

mcqs.q: Which chords form a plagal cadence?
options: V to I.
ii to V.
IV to I (the 'amen' cadence).
Adjusting volume electronically.
